items.title: Claude Code by Anthropic | AI coding agent and assistant

items.title: Claude Code for Enterprise | The AI coding agent for businesses
items.desc: Claude Code gives enterprise engineering teams an autonomous coding agent to deploy with SSO, manage centrally, and measure clearly.

items.title: Claude Duet | A proactive AI agent to assist you
items.desc: Claude Duet is a proactive agent you message. It flags what needs you in your inbox and calendar and drafts replies. Research preview: join the waitlist.

items.title: Claude Science (beta)
items.desc: Claude Science is your AI workbench for scientific research. Works through your research like a skilled scientist, running the analysis and tracing every step. Spend less time stitching pipelines together, and more time on the science.

items.title: Claude Cowork
items.desc: With Claude Cowork, you can start a task at your desk, check in on it from your phone, and get a polished deck, document, or spreadsheet for review. Connect your data; schedule a daily, weekly, or monthly task; and ask for the format you need.

items.title: Claude Design | More than an AI design assistant

items.title: Claude | The AI assistant for work
items.desc: Claude is the AI assistant that gets work done. Hand off tasks, turn ideas into decks, spreadsheets and prototypes, and run scheduled tasks.

items.title: Claude Tag | Add @Claude in any Slack thread
items.desc: Add Claude to Slack and tag it in any thread. It reads the room, takes on tasks, and posts back for everyone to see. In beta for Team and Enterprise plans.

Introducing Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
items.desc: Our most advanced models for coding and knowledge work. Their research capabilities also offer an early glimpse of how AI models will contribute to scientific progress.

items.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items.desc: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, our new models for the hardest technical challenges. Fable 5.2 sets a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.

items.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
items.desc: Claude Haiku 5.5 is our fastest, most capable small model. Built for high-volume work like summarization, subagents, and browser use.

items.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
items.desc: Claude Opus 5.5 leads in agentic coding and knowledge work, and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads.

items.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.desc: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is a clear upgrade over Claude Sonnet 5, runs 30%+ faster, and costs up to 30% less for most work.

items.title: Claude Fable
items.desc: Next generation of intelligence for the hardest knowledge work and coding problems.

items.title: Claude Haiku
items.desc: Our fastest model, a lightweight version of our most powerful AI, at a more affordable price.

items.title: Claude Mythos
items.desc: Our most capable model for cybersecurity and biology research.

items.title: Claude Opus
items.desc: Hybrid reasoning model built for serious coding and AI agents, featuring a 1M context window.

items.title: Claude Sonnet
items.desc: Hybrid reasoning model with fast, capable intelligence for real-time agents and high-volume work, featuring a 1M context window

Anthropic Economic Futures program
items.desc: A multidisciplinary program funding research grants, policy development, and data infrastructure to help society understand and navigate AI's economic transformation.

items.title: The Anthropic Economic Index
items.desc: The Anthropic Economic Index reveals the shape of AI adoption across the world. Here, you can explore the data behind our research to understand how people are using Claude across every US state and hundreds of occupations.  Track the topics that are trending where you live, and see how people are using AI to augment or automate their work—that is, whether they prefer to collaborate with, or delegate to, Claude.

items.desc: At Anthropic, we develop large-scale AI systems, and our research teams help us to create safer, steerable, and more reliable models.

items.desc: ​As Anthropic grows around the globe, we're excited to spend some time with the Korean startup community in partnership with Coxwave.

items.title: What 81,000 people want from AI
items.desc: Last December, tens of thousands of Claude users around the world had a conversation with our AI interviewer to share how they use AI, what they dream it could make possible, and what they fear it might do.

items.title: Claude AI Powers First AI-Planned Mars Rover Drive
items.desc: The first AI-assisted drive on another planet. Claude by Anthropic helped NASA's Perseverance rover travel four hundred meters on Mars.

items.title: The Situation Report
items.desc: A rare Ebola strain is spreading in the DRC, with no confirmed vaccine. Global health organizations are using Claude to respond as fast as possible.

items.desc: We created a marketplace for employees in our San Francisco office, with one big twist. We tasked Claude with buying, selling and negotiating on our colleagues’ behalf.

items.desc: Stay informed about the latest updates to our Responsible Scaling Policy. Learn how Anthropic maintains safety and reliability in AI development.
